newsitem.title: USA: American Stores 15.4 mln shr priced at $43.
newsitem.headline: American Stores 15.4 mln shr priced at $43.

text.p: American Stores Co said on Wednesday a secondary offering of 15.4 million shares of its common stock being, which was being sold by L.S. Skaggs's family and certain family and charitable trusts, was priced at $43 per share.
The company said its repurchase of another 12.2 million shares of common stock from selling stockholders is set to occur on April 8, when the secondary offering is due to close.
American Stores said it granted the underwriters an option to buy another 2.3 million shares to cover over-allotments.
If the option was exercised, the additional shares would be primary shares to be issued by the company, it said.

The company plans to finance the repurchase, which will total $550 million, at first through its bank credit facilities, which were increased in March to $2 billion, it said. It expected to refinance such debt through public equity or debt issuances over the next six to 12 months.
Goldman, Sachs & Co. and J.P. Morgan & Co. are acting as joint lead managers.
